description: Inspect an eero mesh network from the terminal with agent-friendly output for networks, nodes, connected devices, diagnostics, and speed tests.
auth_description: Set EERO_SESSION_TOKEN to an eero session token, or use auth login --chrome with a browser profile that is already signed in.

novel_features.name: Network health snapshot
novel_features.description: One agent-friendly read combines network status, speed summary, client count, node count, DNS, and feature settings.

novel_features.name: Eero inventory
novel_features.description: List all eero nodes in a network with compact agent-friendly output.

novel_features.name: Connected-device inventory
novel_features.description: List connected client devices for a network, with filters and compact JSON for downstream automation.

novel_features.name: Diagnostic report lookup
novel_features.description: Fetch the latest diagnostic report for a network through the same authenticated CLI surface.

novel_features.name: Speed-test history lookup
novel_features.description: Read the latest available speed-test results for a network as structured output.
